# Raatikainen — Gödel’s Incompleteness Theorems (2026)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Panu Raatikainen, “Gödel’s Incompleteness Theorems,” *The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy*, Spring 2026 Edition, ed. Edward N. Zalta and Uri Nodelman (Metaphysics Research Lab, Stanford University, 2026), §1.1, https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/spr2026/entries/goedel-incompleteness/.

**Shortened note:** Raatikainen, “Gödel’s Incompleteness Theorems,” §1.1.

**Bibliography:** Raatikainen, Panu. “Gödel’s Incompleteness Theorems.” *The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy*. Spring 2026 Edition. Edited by Edward N. Zalta and Uri Nodelman. Metaphysics Research Lab, Stanford University, 2026. https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/spr2026/entries/goedel-incompleteness/.

## Essay use

Raatikainen supplies the contemporary technical scope statement for §0/1 #3 and directly corrects a common overreading of the first incompleteness theorem. It is a companion to, not a replacement for, Gödel's 1931 article.

**Claim boundary:** it does not establish the essay's formal-limit synthesis, an unobjectifiable subject, QL, or a metaphysical zero.
